critic_note: Dashed string runs hand-to-balloon so he is still holding it. Open palm, string trailing free, balloon drifting up and away with a gap.
Arms-up looks like cheering; bird is tiny and oddly shaped. Show hands open palms-up with a clear round bird just lifting off between/above them, with motion lines.
Karela looks like a pale-spotted pickle and overlaps his shirt. Make it dark green, long, tapered, with bumpy ridges (dark dashes not light dots), held beside him; keep the scrunched face.
Reads as a little girl, not a doll; wobbly arms. Make a small rag doll: button eyes, yarn hair, stitched seams, floppy limbs, held by a hand or sitting.
Cozy house with smiling family says home, not poor. Show patched clothes, cracked mud wall, empty bowl, sad faces; no cheerful smiles.
Swing kids are tiny, seats look like hats, tree is cropped by the grass block and the grass is a hard-edged rectangle. Bigger kids sitting properly on swing seats, full tree, rounded grass hill.
One big orange disc looks like an orange/snail. Draw 3-4 small golden-orange crisscross-spiral jalebis stacked on a plate with syrup shine.
